market.question: Will the highest temperature in Buenos Aires be 19°C on April 28?

assessment.reasoning: Ezeiza recorded 17°C high on Apr 27. Late-April BA autumn highs typically 15-21°C; 19°C bucket is plausible but one of several adjacent buckets (17, 18, 19, 20). Without a tighter Apr 28 forecast, give ~18%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Exact integer bucket given high day-to-day variability
